name: What kind of warranty or guarantee does Opus Builders offer on their remodeling work?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty or guarantee does Opus Builders offer on their remodeling work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Opus Builders stands behind the quality of our craftsmanship and materials. We provide a comprehensive warranty on our remodeling work, covering structural components and workmanship for a specified period after project completion. Details of the warranty, including terms and duration, are clearly outlined in our client contracts. Our goal is to ensure your long-term satisfaction and peace of mind with your luxury home transformation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Opus Builders provides a comprehensive warranty on structural components and workmanship, with details specified in the client contract, to ensure long-term satisfaction.
